messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — found an edge case in the dashboard snippet for KV cache batching. When batch_window=0 the cost/latency example shows NaN for per-token cost.
kevin: repro steps?
maria: steps: 1) open quickstart dashboard 2) set kv_prefix:test 3) set batching: 0
sam: hmm can you paste the minimal snippet you used?
maria: ```yaml
kvcache:
  prefix: "test"
  batch_window_ms: 0
  max_batch_size: 64
```
asha: that'd cause division-by-zero in the sample calc (we multiply by 1/avg_batch_size). Should guard for 0.
ryan: easy fix — update snippet to use `max(1, avg_batch_size)` or add a note in the example. PR NEEDED.
maria: I started a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4877 (draft) — adds a guard and unit test.
jess: can someone add a short migration note for users who copied the yaml to their presets? something like "if batch_window is zero, sample calc will fallback to per-request accounting"
docs-bot: CI queued for PR #4877 — lint OK, snippet tests failing on go example.
kevin: failing go example is because we parse `batch_window_ms` into an int and then compute average as float — need cast.
sam: I'll push a fix in the go snippet in a follow-up commit. keeping tests green.
asha: also pls add a small line to the console docs: "We recommend batch_window_ms > 5 for production workloads to avoid skewed cost estimates."
ryan: agreed. @maria can you update the PR description and add the console docs change? If not, I'll do it tomorrow.
maria: can do. adding console note and the migration blurb now.
jess: once PR is updated, can someone do a quick sanity check in playground to ensure embedding cost numbers look sane? I'll do that after lunch.
kevin: thanks all — blocker cleared once PR merges. :thumbsup:
